user_rules.agent_prompt_prefix: When giving lines to paste into OVMS Agent, omit the OVMS-AGENT> prompt prefix.
user_rules.vax_external_identifier_limit: Treat DEC C/VAX 31-character external identifier limit as hard. Audit every newly introduced externally visible function/global/linker-visible symbol before packaging every milestone/fix.
user_rules.vax_c_compatibility: Avoid implicit function declarations and non-C89 constructs in VAX-facing C.
user_rules.github_source_of_truth: Use connected GitHub as source of truth for committed repository files, searches, branches, diffs, issues, PRs, comments, and history. Ask user for OpenVMS commands only for runtime/build/RMS/DCL/live acceptance evidence GitHub cannot provide.

accepted_milestones.M265: GAP-008 RMS-aware guarded Git restore, including post-merge RMS record-format correction

m265.vax_symbol_limit_status: 20 characters, <=31; corrective PR adds no production linker-visible symbols.
m265.initial_acceptance: Guarded restore created a new highest RMS version, preserved prior versions, restored Git HEAD as effective, and honored workspace approval/write gate.

post_merge_defect.discovery: Native git pull to merged main failed on TEST/GAP008_RMS.TXT with file exists. Recovery advanced HEAD/index via git reset --mixed --no-refresh, then used GITRESTORE on incoming files.
post_merge_defect.failure: GITRESTORE of BUILD_OPENAI_MODULES.COM and openai_modules.opt created 0KB effective files; subsequent @BUILD failed with 136 undefined linker symbols.
post_merge_defect.root_cause: rms_replace_text_file used bare creat(path,0) for existing non-stream .OPT/.COM/.CLD files instead of explicit OpenVMS variable-record/carriage-control attributes.
post_merge_defect.fix: Corrective PR #29 uses creat(path,0,"rat=cr","rfm=var") for the non-stream control-file replacement path.
post_merge_defect.recovery: Known-good historical Stream_LF versions of BUILD_OPENAI_MODULES.COM and openai_modules.opt were copied forward with destination trailing semicolon; @BUILD then passed and Git was clean.

corrective_regression.scope: 4 files, +180/-7 relative to initial M265 merge; no unrelated changes.
corrective_regression.coverage: Exercises both Stream_LF and native variable-record .OPT/.COM restore paths. Stream mutation creates a new highest RMS version rather than modifying the original tracked version. Test cleanup removes only versions it created.
corrective_regression.live_result: PASS: strengthened @BUILD completed with all regression tests passed; final git status contained only unrelated untracked m264_gap007.cob; fixture TYPE matched Git HEAD exactly.
corrective_regression.rms_result: Variable-record restore produced nonzero variable-length files with carriage-return carriage control instead of 0KB files.

separate_findings: Native Git checkout/pull on this OpenVMS Git build can still fail on RMS-versioned paths; safe recovery used git reset --mixed --no-refresh followed by guarded GITRESTORE for affected tracked files.
